Question:
Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH qualified_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bb.striker
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker, bb.innings_no
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) > 50
),
striker_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as num_strikers,
    ROUND(AVG(total_runs), 2) as average_total_runs
FROM striker_totals st
JOIN qualified_strikers qs ON st.striker = qs.striker

[C]
SQL:
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.striker, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        AND bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
strikers_with_50_plus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE match_total_runs > 50
),
striker_totals AS (
    SELECT sm.striker, SUM(sm.match_total_runs) as total_runs
    FROM striker_match_runs sm
    JOIN strikers_with_50_plus sw ON sm.striker = sw.striker
    GROUP BY sm.striker
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as count,
    SUM(total_runs) as sum_runs,
    AVG(total_runs) as avg_runs
FROM striker_totals

WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    -- Calculate total runs per striker per match
    SELECT bb.striker, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
      AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    -- Find strikers who have at least one match with > 50 runs
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE match_total_runs > 50
),
striker_total_runs AS (
    -- Calculate total runs for each qualifying striker across ALL matches
    SELECT q.striker, SUM(smr.match_total_runs) as total_runs
    FROM qualifying_strikers q
    JOIN striker_match_runs smr ON q.striker = smr.striker
    GROUP BY q.striker
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as average_total_runs
FROM striker_total_runs
